# WhimsyLabs

> WhimsyLabs is award-winning virtual laboratory software for science education. Students conduct realistic Biology, Chemistry, and Physics experiments in a fully simulated sandbox lab, on desktop, mobile, or VR, while WhimsyCat, the built-in AI tutor, assesses their practical skills. WhimsyCat has no student chat window: it infers everything from students' actions in the lab, so pupils never type prompts or receive generated text. Winner of the BETT 2025 Kids Judge Award (Best Science Lab, Start Up).

The site is available in English (default, no URL prefix), Spanish (/es/), French (/fr/), German (/de/), and Japanese (/jp/).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://whimsylabs.ai/): What WhimsyLabs is, how the physics-first simulation and AI assessment work
- [Features](https://whimsylabs.ai/features/): Full feature set, realistic simulations, AI assessment, cross-platform access
- [Services](https://whimsylabs.ai/services/): Solutions for schools and K-12 classrooms, trials, and onboarding
- [AI-Proof Assessment](https://whimsylabs.ai/ai-assessment/): Why process-based assessment beats AI detection, and how WhimsyLabs grades technique
- [How to Choose Virtual Lab Software](https://whimsylabs.ai/choose-virtual-lab/): A 12-point buyer's checklist for schools comparing virtual lab platforms
- [SEND Science Practicals](https://whimsylabs.ai/send/): Accessible practicals, control remapping, text-to-speech, self-paced modes
- [Virtual Chemistry Lab](https://whimsylabs.ai/chemistry/): Titrations, reactions, electrolysis with simulated chemistry
- [Virtual Biology Lab](https://whimsylabs.ai/biology/): Dissections, microscopy, and physiology
- [Virtual Physics Lab](https://whimsylabs.ai/physics/): Mechanics, circuits, waves on a real-time physics engine
- [FAQ](https://whimsylabs.ai/faq/): 40+ answered questions on pricing, setup, VR requirements, and curriculum fit
- [Grants](https://whimsylabs.ai/grants/): Funding routes schools can use to pay for WhimsyLabs
- [Data Security](https://whimsylabs.ai/data-security/): Student data protection, GDPR/FERPA/COPPA compliance
- [Contact](https://whimsylabs.ai/contact/): Book a demo or request a school trial
